mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) signals strong economic expansion, leading to higher corporate profits and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 growth rate rises, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 4.0%, it signals a tight labor market and strong consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0%, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals an aggressive monetary tightening cycle amid high inflation, which compresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL rise, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% annually), a rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses equity valuations through higher discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%), SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises, or the Rank IC for the regime-specific signal falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1500.0 thousand units, it signals robust housing market activity and strong consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST > 1500.0, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a strengthening labor market and rising consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS rises, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) signals a broad-based economic expansion, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where both INDPRO and HOUST rise, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, a decline in retail sales (RSAFS) signals weakening consumer demand and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions, SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where RSAFS declines, or the Rank IC for the regime-specific signal falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
